header.title: Side Projects
header.description: A showcase of my personal projects, features, and technical work. I enjoy creating silly apps to enhance my learning, and reverse engineering things to understand how they work.

examples.label: Emojigraph
examples.title: Emojigraph — iOS Genmoji & AI Image App
examples.description: A native SwiftUI app that lets you create, collect, and share custom Genmoji using Apple's Image Playground API. Features on-device image generation via Core ML Stable Diffusion, daily themed challenges with SwiftData persistence, a Customoji local Swift package, Supabase backend, and Ollama-powered profile analysis tools. Supports iOS, iPadOS, and Mac Catalyst.

examples.label: Small Joys
examples.title: Small Joys iOS Widget
examples.description: A simple iOS widget that provides daily positive affirmations and small, actionable joy tasks (like noticing lovely things outside or texting a friend) to foster resilience, connection, and self-care. Powered by Apple Intelligence, it personalises the affirmations based on the users mood, strengths and interests.
